tools.name: get_quote_status
tools.description: Check a submitted quotation. While pending review, only the pending-review state is returned. Once QUOTED, the response includes the quoted products, approved line prices and total amount.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Submit one or more structured titanium line items for quotation review. Each item may include sectionShape (ROUND, HEX, FLAT or UNKNOWN). Only call after the customer has reviewed all interpreted items and explicitly agreed to submit them.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_quote_status · Public sink: request_quote.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_quote_status · Public sink: request_quote

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_quote_status" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Check whether a previously submitted quotation enquiry is still waiting for human pricing or has been quoted." → after: "Check a submitted quotation. While pending review, only the pending-review state is returned. Once QUOTED, the response includes the quoted products, approved line prices and total amount."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
